content:
Currently, when I switch between branches in projects downstream of Mathlib that use different Lean/Mathlib versions I always need to wait a bit before I can continue working. As far as I understand, the .lake directory only contains build files/oleans for one specific version so all of its content has to be switched out before the project files themselves can be checked. Is there a way to set things up to avoid this? Sometimes, I'd find it handy to compare two files side-by-side interactively, but the only solution I can see to achieve this is to clone the repository twice.

On the user experience side, it also creates a hiccup when you switch to a branch without realising it's on a different version. The default behaviour is that Lean then just starts checking Mathlib files from scratch, but in most cases I want to use the cache instead.
Git worktrees allow having different folders with shared git data, does that suit your needs?
Thanks, that's a good point. I'll experiment with those..
